name: What does a typical pool area renovation involve?

mainEntity.name: What does a typical pool area renovation involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical pool area renovation can range from minor cosmetic updates to a complete overhaul. Common elements include replastering or resurfacing the pool, updating pool decking materials like pavers, concrete, or stone, adding new features such as water features, lighting, or a spa, and enhancing surrounding landscaping or hardscaping. It might also involve upgrading pool equipment, repairing structural issues, or redesigning the entire outdoor living space to better suit current needs and aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pool area renovation can involve replastering, new decking, adding features like water elements or lighting, and updating landscaping or equipment.
